verdict.rationale: Gecko documents compiler-accurate cross-file analysis for eight major languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, Scala, C# and Rust. That covers a large share of typical organizational stacks. Nothing in the evidence shows package-ecosystem or dependency scanning, and C/C++, PHP and Ruby are absent from the list. One hands-on C-project scan also found nothing, which suggests C is not a strength rather than contradicting any claim. Missing for 10: package ecosystem / dependency (SCA) coverage, support for C/C++, PHP, Ruby and other common languages, independent corroboration of per-language accuracy.
